weakness: Shared password-only 'oncall' SYS-02 account with write access to county buildings; no account types, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; late removal of a former technician
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-001, R-003; P03 G-002
remediation_plan: Named SYS-02 accounts with MFA for the 3 technicians and retire 'oncall'; owner approval for administrator accounts; monthly reconciliation of all user lists (POL-02 B.5)
milestones: 2026-09-30 named accounts licensed; 2026-10-15 'oncall' disabled; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: About $600 a year (SYS-02 licenses); staff time

weakness: Gateway administrator logins, gateway VPN, and the 'oncall' account accept a password alone; MFA on MSP backup console and RMM not evidenced
remediation_plan: Certificate plus one-time code on the gateway VPN; named gateway administrator accounts; MSP screenshots of MFA on the backup console and RMM
milestones: 2026-09-30 MSP evidence; 2026-10-31 VPN MFA on 2 pilot gateways; 2026-11-30 all 7 gateways
resources_required: Lead Controls Technician time (about 16 hours); MSP labor

weakness: No documented remote access rules or connection requirements; technician VPN reaches whole BAS networks
remediation_plan: Remote access rules (POL-02 B.6) and a one-page connection standard; limit VPN to supervisory and engineering ports
milestones: 2026-09-30 rules published; 2026-11-30 VPN limits on all gateways

weakness: Controller programs, door schedules, gateway and platform configurations not backed up; no restore test; integrity not verified
source: P07; P01 R-005, R-006; P04 finding 3
remediation_plan: Engineering repository in the suite (picked up by SYS-08); monthly SYS-01 and SYS-02 configuration exports; program hashes; quarterly restore tests of SYS-08 and 3 controller programs
milestones: 2026-09-30 repository created; 2026-10-31 first SYS-08 restore test; 2026-11-30 first program restore test

weakness: MSP and SYS-02 vendor have no security or incident notice terms; no provider oversight; face module data terms missing
remediation_plan: MSP security addendum (RMM MFA, named technicians, 24-hour incident notice); SYS-02 vendor questionnaire; SYS-01 vendor letter on the face module; yearly provider review (POL-02 A.5)
milestones: 2026-08-20 SYS-01 SOC 2 review done; 2026-10-31 SYS-01 vendor letter; 2026-12-31 MSP addendum signed and SYS-02 questionnaire received
resources_required: About $600 a year (MSP review); owner time

weakness: No time limit for disabling access; shared secrets not changed at departure; no exit reminder
remediation_plan: Same-day termination checklist covering all platforms, gateways, shared secrets, keys, badges, and PIV return through the prime

weakness: Default password found on one gateway; 8-character shared gateway passwords kept in a notes app; no change rules
remediation_plan: Company password manager; unique 14-character gateway passwords; commissioning checklist with a default password check; quarterly check of all 7 gateways
milestones: 2026-08-05 parks gateway password changed; 2026-09-30 password manager; 2026-10-31 all gateway passwords rotated

weakness: No review of SYS-01, SYS-02, suite, or gateway logs
remediation_plan: Weekly 30-minute review checklist (new SYS-01 administrators, door schedule changes, SYS-02 writes against work orders, risky suite sign-ins); results to the owner monthly
milestones: 2026-10-05 first weekly review; 2026-10-31 first monthly report
resources_required: Office and Compliance Manager time (30 minutes a week)

weakness: No inventory of company components; customer devices reached by gateways not reconciled (11 city controllers missing from the CMMS list)
remediation_plan: One inventory of devices, gateways, tenants, and data locations (POL-04 4.5); quarterly reconciliation with the CMMS; add the 11 controllers
milestones: 2026-09-15 11 controllers added to the CMMS; 2026-11-30 inventory complete

weakness: Gateway firmware 2 releases behind on 5 of 7; no advisory monitoring; no update time limits
remediation_plan: Quarterly firmware review and update in windows approved by the customer; CISA ICS advisory check monthly; 14-day limit for critical laptop updates in the MSP contract
milestones: 2026-10-31 advisory subscription; 2026-11-30 all gateways updated; 2026-12-31 MSP contract term
resources_required: Lead Controls Technician time; MSP labor

weakness: Staff not told when or how to report; customer clocks not written
remediation_plan: Reporting card for every technician (POL-03 4.2); P08 notification matrix briefing; tabletop with the county and MSP

weakness: Electronic CUI in the general shared folder and in 2 laptops' downloads folders; USB drives not controlled
remediation_plan: Restricted CUI folder for 4 named people; delete local copies; encrypted company USB drives only; CUI training
milestones: 2026-09-15 local copies deleted; 2026-10-31 restricted folder and encrypted USB drives

weakness: No screening of CT-F parts against FAR 52.204-23, 52.204-25, and FASCSA orders; no SAM.gov search
remediation_plan: Screening checklist and approved supplier list (POL-02 A.6); SAM.gov FASCSA search before each CT-F order and at least quarterly
milestones: 2026-09-30 first SAM.gov search recorded; 2026-10-31 checklist and supplier list in use
